description.en: Devin account login via the same PKCE flow the Devin CLI uses, Connect-RPC chat, usage windows and the CLI model catalog collapsed to one row per family with its reasoning efforts.
description.zh: 通过 Devin CLI 同款 PKCE 流程登录 Devin 账号，Connect-RPC 对话，用量窗口；CLI 模型目录按家族折叠为一行并列出其推理档位。

docs.en: Sign in with your Devin (Cognition) account; the plugin exchanges the PKCE code for a session token, drives ApiServerService/GetChatMessage for chat, and reads quota from GetUserStatus. The model list is collapsed to one row per family, each carrying the reasoning efforts its variants are at, and a request is resolved to the variant the effort asks for.
docs.zh: 使用 Devin（Cognition）账号登录；插件将 PKCE 授权码换取会话令牌，经 ApiServerService/GetChatMessage 对话，并从 GetUserStatus 读取用量。模型列表按家族折叠为一行，每行列出其变体所在的推理档位；请求会解析为该档位对应的变体。

description.en: Authorises through app.devin.ai with the Devin CLI's PKCE flow; the loopback redirect hands the plugin a session token.
description.zh: 经由 app.devin.ai 使用 Devin CLI 的 PKCE 流程授权；本机回调将授权码换成会话令牌。
